dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Mid-dorsal region displays 4 prominent 'O' shaped annuli with sharp pixel-level transitions from low-intensity (dark) outer borders to high-intensity (light) centers. Edges are jagged at the sub-millimeter level, particularly on the anterior-most ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the lower lateral-anterior quadrant, exhibiting minimal internal variance and localized spatial clustering.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest dorsal annuli form an irregular kite-shaped polygon. A sub-constellation of three high-intensity blobs below the mid-section forms a right-angled triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of interlocking, figure-eight shaped high-contrast structures in the central lateral field where individual macro-annuli boundaries merge.
